items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: You see, most of Montgomery's tank corps was Indian Canadians and they had a trombone player, a boy name of Frank Johnston, I think.

ctx.x: Frank -- Francis Goody Goudie. G-o-u-d-i-e, yeah Big Boy, very lovely person, very lovely person.
So, Big Boy, and they worked together. This saxaphone player that I will tell you about later, Robert
